[SWS_DM_00984] Return of cancellation status
⌈
A call to ara::diag:-
:CancellationHandler::IsCanceled shall return false if the corresponding
Diagnostic Conversation is not canceled. On Cancellation of this Diagnos-
tic Conversation ara::diag::CancellationHandler::IsCanceled shall
return true until the ara::diag::CancellationHandler is destructed.
⌋
